name: Universal Plastic Bag Manufacturing
old_description: Universal Plastic: A Leading U.S. Manufacturer of Plastic Packaging Solutions
about:
Universal Plastic Bag Manufacturing operates from a manufacturing facility in Ontario, California. The company produces plastic packaging solutions for a range of commercial and industrial sectors.

The company manufactures both stock and custom plastic bags, including poly bags, pallet covers, reclosable bags, gusseted bags, trash can liners, mattress bags, and garment bags. It also produces poly tubing and specialty items such as "Refrigerate" seal-top bags. Production runs from its California facility, serving wholesale and custom orders.

Its customer base spans packaging manufacturers, contract packagers, distributors, and fulfillment providers, as well as pharmaceutical manufacturers, laboratories, food processors, commercial kitchens, hospitals, and medical device manufacturers. The company highlights service to the packaging, pharmaceutical, food, and medical and healthcare industries, along with retail and industrial operations.

Universal Plastic emphasizes its U.S.-based manufacturing as a differentiator, citing dependable quality, consistent supply, and responsive customer service. It positions its expertise as supporting product protection, operational efficiency, supply chain reliability, product freshness, food safety, and regulatory compliance for regulated industries.
